title: Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement
desc:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail.

 - Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation.

 - Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions.

 - Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations.

 - Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans.

 - Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort.

 - Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products.

 - Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data.

 - Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled.

 - Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution.

 - Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners.

 - Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work.

 



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Applied AI Engineer, People
desc: Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. Our goal is to build one of the first AI-native People Operations systems inside a scaling technology company. Instead of a large administrative HR organization, we’re building a small, high-leverage People team powered by smart systems, operational excellence, and AI-enabled processes we invent as we go. Our People team knows our Atomizers (that’s what we call our people) but lacks the technical skills to build systems that scale our people practices. You’ll be the person who turns our ideas into working tools, uncovers redundancy, gets more out of the platforms we already use, and builds AI proficiency across the team. Help us keep up with a high volume of open roles without losing quality or candidate experience. Teach AI fluency. Run hands-on sessions, write simple playbooks and build templates so non-technical teammates can use Claude, ChatGPT and agents confidently. Keep exploring. Stay on top of new AI tools and practices, test them, and bring forward what's actually useful. Handle data responsibly. Treat employee and candidate data with the care and confidentiality it needs. Strong proficiency with Claude Code, plus comfort with Python, SQL and APIs. Experience building dashboards or reporting from messy data. A track record of building efficient, repeatable practices that scale, not one-off scripts. The ability to explain technical ideas in plain language to non-engineers, and patience teaching them. Curiosity about how teams work, and a habit of asking "why do we do it this way?" Good judgment about privacy and handling sensitive information. Nice to Have: Familiarity with both Claude and ChatGPT ecosystems, including MCP connectors, custom GPTs or Projects. Experience with workflow tools or BI platforms. Interest in people operations, talent, or organizational design. Why Join: You'll build agents that reach every team in the company, with real ownership from day one. Your work will shape how a fast-growing deep-tech company hires and supports its people. You'll have the space to experiment with the newest AI tools and see your impact right away. The compensation for this position also includes equity and benefits. Salary Range $110,000 — $150,000 USD Atomic Machines

Job Description We are seeking a highly motivated Research Associate to join our In Vivo Discovery team focused on developing targeted vectors to reprogram cells in vivo for the treatment of cancer. The Research Associate, Research Discovery role is an entry-level scientific professional who performs hands-on laboratory experiments as part of a research team. Working under close supervision from experienced scientists, this individual executes routine experimental procedures and simple to moderately complex assays, following established protocols and good laboratory practices to ensure reliable results. This individual may also support the execution of small animal model studies to evaluate experimental constructs and connect mechanistic findings to in vivo outcomes. The Research Associate systematically collects and analyzes data with guidance, maintains clear and thorough documentation of experiments, and communicates findings to support ongoing projects. This role emphasizes building core laboratory skills and scientific understanding, adaptability in learning new techniques, and collaboration within a team-oriented research environment. Key Responsibilities Plan and perform assigned laboratory experiments of simple to moderate complexity under close supervision, following established protocols and procedures to obtain reliable results. Support hands-on in vivo mouse studies including routine animal handling, dosing/injections (e.g., intravenous tail vein and intraperitoneal, as applicable), IVIS imaging support, blood collection, tissue harvest/dissection, and sample processing in accordance with approved protocols and SOPs. Demonstrate adaptability by learning new experimental techniques or operating new instrumentation with guidance and continuously improve skills through feedback and practice. Contribute to a positive, team-oriented lab culture by being reliable and proactive, offering assistance to colleagues and helping to train new team members on basic laboratory procedures when needed. Maintain mammalian cell lines and primary human cells using sterile technique in a biosafety cabinet. Occasional weekend work might be required. Familiarity with basic data analysis methods; able to process experimental data and use common software tools (e.g., spreadsheets, graphing programs) to summarize and visualize results. Excellent documentation and record-keeping skills to maintain clear and thorough electronic lab notebooks and records of experiments, observations, and outcomes. Good communication skills (written and verbal) to effectively report experimental results and observations to team members and supervisors. Knowledge of and commitment to laboratory safety procedures and good laboratory practices, ensuring quality and compliance in all experimental activities. Strong organizational and time management abilities to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and meet project deadlines. Collaborative working style and a positive team-oriented attitude, with a willingness to work closely with colleagues, share knowledge, and contribute to team goals. Eagerness to learn and adapt quickly to new techniques or equipment, with an openness to feedback and a commitment to continuous improvement. desc: Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. Combining data, research, technology and trading expertise has shaped QRT’s collaborative mindset which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors. You will provide day-to-day production support for QRT’s platform for accessing internally hosted and external LLMs. Based in the US, you will support users during US business hours and coordinate with colleagues in other regions to ensure effective incident handovers. This is a hands-on support role, focused on incident resolution, user assistance and established operational procedures-not platform architecture, model development or infrastructure engineering. Monitor platform health using existing dashboards, logs and alerts; identify availability, latency and error-rate problems and perform approved recovery actions using established runbooks. Troubleshoot gateway and model-provider issues, including authentication failures, rate limits, timeouts, connection resets, streaming failures and regional performance differences. Determine whether incidents originate in a user’s client or configuration, the platform gateway, an internally hosted model or an external LLM provider; collect diagnostic evidence and coordinate escalation to the appropriate team or vendor. Support coding assistants, API clients and developer workspaces connected to QRT’s LLM platform, including Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, PI and Coder; investigate compatibility issues following client or vendor updates. Help users configure supported integrations, select the appropriate regional endpoint and migrate API access from Open WebUI to the direct gateway. Carry out operational checks for releases and configuration changes, including non-production validation, post-release smoke testing and approved rollback procedures, in coordination with platform engineering. Working proficiency in Python, Bash and/or PowerShell for operational checks, log analysis and straightforward support automation. Practical experience interpreting metrics, logs, traces and dashboards to distinguish a platform-wide incident from a user-, client-, model- or region-specific issue. Awareness of access controls, sensitive-data handling and safe diagnostic practices, including avoiding exposure of prompts, credentials or confidential content in support records. You will work at the intersection of data, product strategy, and execution—analyzing product performance, identifying trends and opportunities, and turning findings into clear insights, requirements, documentation, and coordinated product changes. This is a great opportunity for a curious, motivated analyst who enjoys working with data and asking thoughtful questions. The team can teach the products and industry; the strongest candidates will bring analytical ability, initiative, attention to detail, and a genuine interest in understanding how products are performing and how they can improve. Turn complex data into clear reports, visualizations, and actionable insights for leaders and business partners. Conduct competitive research and support decisions involving product positioning, pricing, rates, forms, and underwriting guidelines. Translate business needs into requirements, user stories, workflows, and product documentation. Support product changes from planning through QA, regulatory filing, release, implementation, and post-launch analysis. Partner with Product Management, Actuarial, Underwriting, Sales, Technology, and other teams to deliver improvements. Proactively identify product, reporting, and process gaps and recommend practical solutions. Why Join This Team Make a visible impact on growing products with significant opportunity for improvement and innovation. Gain broad exposure to the product lifecycle and collaborate with teams across the business. Join a supportive, flexible team with an approachable leader who invests in individual development. Build varied experience and grow toward future opportunities such as Senior Product Analyst or Product Manager. Enjoy the ownership of a startup-style environment backed by Assurant’s stability and resources.
